capabilities: Normalize LaTeX \(...\) and \[...\] delimiters to Obsidian math
Repair Markdown table separators, column counts, and escaped content
Close unclosed fenced code blocks and normalize heading, list, and Callout prefixes
Preview changes before writing and scan the current document, folder, or vault
Restore the most recent repair snapshot and normalize URL-encoded note paths
disambiguation: Not a style formatter that rewrites correct Markdown layout; it only repairs content it detects as broken, and skips changes it cannot make with high confidence.
extras: Has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; no network access and no note content sent to external services; warns against syncing the plugin folder through a vault sync service; Chinese instructions in README_CN.md; not yet in the official Community Plugins directory.
motivation: Repairs formatting mistakes commonly produced by AI assistants and copied Markdown.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fix broken Markdown such as wrong LaTeX delimiters, malformed table separators, unclosed code fences, or URL-encoded file names.

relations.evidence: Install and enable BRAT from Obsidian's Community Plugins directory.

summary: Conservative local-only tool that repairs common Markdown errors from AI output and copied text, with previews and snapshot recovery.
